data.text: Qur'ek mein baar baar aane wale aasaan alfaaz. Inke matlab samjhein:

data.title: Qawaid o Tanbeeh (Grammar Notes)
data.text: Arabi zaban mein [ اَلْ ] ka matlab “yeh” (khaas) hota hai, aur yeh un alfaaz ke shuru mein lagta hai jinka matlab “yeh” ho. Khaas logon ke naamon (maslan: مُحَمَّدٌ, مُوسَىٰ, فِرْعَوْن) ke shuru mein aam taur par [ اَلْ ] nahi aata. Agar iss sabaq ya aane wale asbaaq mein koi naya lafz mile, toh aasaani ke liye use highlight kar lein.

data.title: Muannath (Feminine) ki Pehchan
data.text: Jin alfaaz ke aakhir mein gol 'ta' [ة / ـة] hoti hai, woh muannath (feminine) hote hain. Gaur karein ke iss sabaq aur pichle sabaq mein kaun kaun se alfaaz muannath hain?
Pichle do asbaaq ki tarah, aap mein alfaaz ke maani bhi jaante honge. Nisbatan naye alfaaz ke maani samne likh diye gaye hain:

data.title: Lafz se Jumla (Words toh Sentences)
data.text: Lafz se lafz mil kar jumla banta hai. Quran-e-Pak ki aayatein bhi mukhtalif jumle hain. Jis tarah ab aap alfaaz samajhne lage hain, usi tarah mein Sha' Allah bohot jald Quran-e-Pak ki aayatein bhi samajhne lagenge.
Yahan kuch aam taur par maaroof Arabi alfaaz diye gaye hain. Aapki sahulat ke liye nisbatan naye alfaaz ke ma'ani darj kar diye gaye hain. Faraham karda jagahon mein inke matlab likhein:
Munasib hai ke iss kitaab mein jo lafz aapko mushkil lage use highlight ya underline kar lein, taake woh numayan ho jaye aur yaad rakhna aasan ho.

data.text: Darj zail alfaaz ke samne unke maani likhein. Nisbatan naye alfaaz ke maani darj kar diye gaye hain:

Agar kisi lafz ke shuru mein [ اَلْـ ] aaye, toh aam taur par uske aakhiri harf par Pesh (Dammah) [ ُ ] aata hai, jaise [ اَلرَّحْمٰنُ ]. Lekin jumle ke hisaab se aakhir mein Zabar (Fatha) [ َ ] ya Zer (Kasrah) [ ِ ] bhi aa sakti hai. iss se lafz ke maani par koi farq nahi padta.
Ab aap darj zail Qur'ani fiqron aur aayaton ko khud samajh aur tarjuma kar sakte hain.

data.text: Kuch Aur Qur'ani Jama ke Alfaaz (Jama Muannath Saalim — Suffix ات)

Bahut se jama ke alfaaz hain jo [ا] aur [ت] par khatam hote hain jaise [الْجَنَّاتُ] aur [الْبَرَكَاتُ]. Yeh Qur'ani alfaaz aam taur par cheezon ke majmoo'e ya auraton ke giroh ka matlab dete hain. Darj zail alfaaz ko dhyan se padhiye aur unke ma'ani samjhiye.

data.text: Upar diye gaye pehle column mein woh alfaaz hain jo aap pichhle asbaaq mein padh chuke hain. Doosre column mein wahi alfaaz thode se farq ke sath dobara aaye hain: unke shuru mein (الْـ) nahi hai aur aakhir mein tanween (ً ٍ ٌ) hai, jaise (كِتَابٌ). Kisi lafz ke shuru mein (لَـ) lagaane se us mein 'yaqeenan', 'beshak' ya 'bila-shuba' ke ma'ani paida ho jaate hain. iss tarah poore lafz ka ma'ana 'yaqeenan woh ek ... hai' hota hai. Ab aap darj zail jumlon ko khud samajh kar tarjuma kar sakte hain:
